[STEP S001]
[PARAGRAPH 1]
You must make haste for you sense it is not safe to linger by the smoking remains of the ruined monastery. The black-winged beasts could return at any moment. You must set out for the Sommlending capital of Holmgard and tell the King the terrible news of the massacre: that the whole élite of Kai warriors, save yourself, have been slaughtered. Without the Kai Lords to lead her armies, Sommerlund will be at the mercy of their ancient enemy, the Darklords. Fighting back tears, you bid farewell to your dead kinsmen. Silently, you promise that their deaths will be avenged. You turn away from the ruins and carefully descend the steep track. At the foot of the hill, the path splits into two directions, both leading into a large wood.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S001-C01. If you wish to use your Kai Discipline of Sixth Sense, turn to 141.
S001-C02. If you wish to take the right path into the wood, turn to 85.
S001-C03. If you wish to follow the left track, turn to 275.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S001-C01. If you wish to use your Kai Discipline of Sixth Sense, turn to 141.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Kai availability or mechanical route

[STEP S002]
[PARAGRAPH 141]
Your Sixth Sense has warned you that some of the creatures that attacked the monastery are searching the two paths for any survivors of their raid, but you can avoid both tracks by making your way through the undergrowth of the woods.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S002-C01. If you wish to head south, turn to 56.
S002-C02. Or if you wish to cut through the heavier foliage towards the northeast, turn to 333.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S002-C02. Or if you wish to cut through the heavier foliage towards the northeast, turn to 333.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S003]
[PARAGRAPH 333]
You have cut your way through the thick undergrowth for nearly half an hour when you hear the beat of wings high above the trees. Looking up you can just make out the shape of a Kraan approaching from the north. It is one of the monsters that attacked the monastery and on its back are two grey-skinned creatures armed with long spears. These are Mountain Giaks—evil servants of the Darklords, full of hatred and malice. Many centuries ago, their ancestors were used by the Darklords to build the infernal city of Helgedad, which lies in the volcanic wastelands beyond the Durncrag range of mountains. The construction of the city was long and torturous and only the strongest of the Giaks survived the heat and poisonous atmosphere of Helgedad. Hidden by the trees, you freeze, keeping absolutely still as the Kraan passes overhead and disappears towards the south. When you are sure that it has gone, you move off once again into the forest.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S003-C01. Turn to 131.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S003-C01. Turn to 131.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S004]
[PARAGRAPH 131]
You have covered about a quarter of a mile when you hear shouting and a noise like thunderclaps ahead. Edging nearer, you soon make out a clearing that you recognize to be the site of the ruins of Raumas, an ancient forest temple. A war party of Giaks, some twenty-five to thirty strong, are attacking the ruins from all sides. Many more of the Giaks are dead or dying among the broken pillars of marble, but still they assault whatever is hidden inside. Suddenly, a bolt of blue lightning rips through the front rank of Giaks sending the armour-clad creatures tumbling in all directions. A Giak, taller than the others and dressed from head to foot in black chainmail, curses at his troops as he whips them forward with a barbed flail. With weapon ready, you move to the edge of the clearing, under cover of the thick foliage, and try to catch a glimpse of the defenders. To your amazement, the ruins are being defended by a young man no older than yourself. You recognize his sky-blue robes, embroidered with stars. He is a young theurgist of the Magicians’ Guild of Toran: an apprentice in magic. Five Giaks charge forward, their spears raised to stab the apprentice as he hurriedly retreats deeper into the ruins. You see him turn and raise his left hand just before a bolt of blue flame shoots from his fingertips into the snarling Giak soldiers. Close to where you are hidden, you see a Giak scuttle past and climb one of the pillars of the temple. He has a long curved dagger in his mouth and he is about to jump on the young wizard standing below.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S004-C01. If you wish to shout a warning to the wizard, turn to 241.
S004-C02. If you wish to run forward and attack the Giak when he jumps, turn to 55.
S004-C03. If you wish to pick up a chunk of temple marble and throw it at the Giak’s head, turn to 302.
S004-C04. Or if you would rather turn and leave the battle area and run back into the woods, turn to 101.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S004-C04. Or if you would rather turn and leave the battle area and run back into the woods, turn to 101.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S005]
[PARAGRAPH 101]
The noise of battle soon fades behind you but the ensuing silence is broken by a voice in your head that accuses you of being a coward, and deserting a fellow human in danger. You try to rid yourself of your nagging conscience by telling yourself that your mission is far more important, and that not only is the life of the young magician in peril but the lives of all your countrymen depend on you reaching the capital alive. Suddenly, the sight of a Giak war party in the distance makes you quickly take cover and hide. But it is too late—they have spotted you and you must run as fast as you can.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S005-C01. Turn to 281.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S005-C01. Turn to 281.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S006]
[PARAGRAPH 281]
As you race through the trees you can hear the horrible cackle of the Giaks close behind you. Soon the trees start to thin out and directly ahead you can see a rocky hillside.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S006-C01. If you break cover and climb up the hill, turn to 311.
S006-C02. If you change direction and continue your run through the forest, turn to 77.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S006-C02. If you change direction and continue your run through the forest, turn to 77.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S007]
[PARAGRAPH 77]
The Mountain Giaks are unaccustomed to pursuing their prey through forests and you soon outdistance them, until finally the sound of their grunts and curses disappears completely. When you are satisfied that they have given up the chase, you stop for a few minutes to catch your breath and check your equipment. With the memory of your ruined monastery still blazing in your mind, you gather up your meagre belongings and push on.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S007-C01. Turn to 19.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S007-C01. Turn to 19.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S008]
[PARAGRAPH 19]
Just ahead through the tall trees you can see clumps of dark-red gallowbrush, a thorny briar with sharp crimson barbs. The common name for this forest weed is ‘Sleeptooth’, for the thorns are very sharp and can make you feel weak and sleepy if they scratch your skin.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S008-C01. If you have the Kai Discipline of Tracking, turn to 69.
S008-C02. You can avoid the Sleeptooth by returning to the track. Turn to 272.
S008-C03. Or you can push on through the briars, deeper into the forest, by turning to 119.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S008-C02. You can avoid the Sleeptooth by returning to the track. Turn to 272.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S009]
[PARAGRAPH 272]
Keeping a watchful eye on the sky above, you move quickly along the track. You recall that this route leads to Fogwood, a small cluster of huts that have been used by a family of charcoal burners for nearly fifty years. After twenty minutes you reach the edge of a clearing where the huts are grouped in a small circle. There is no sign of the usual mist of wood smoke which gives Fogwood its apt name, and the huts are unusually quiet.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S009-C01. If you have the Kai Discipline of Tracking, you may turn to 134.
S009-C02. If you do not possess this skill, you prepare your weapon and stealthily approach the huts. Turn to 305.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S009-C01. If you have the Kai Discipline of Tracking, you may turn to 134.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Kai availability or mechanical route

[STEP S010]
[PARAGRAPH 134]
Using your skills, you detect Giak tracks around the perimeter of the clearing. The prints are fresh and you can tell that these cruel minions of the Darklords were in this area less than two hours ago.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S010-C01. Forewarned by this knowledge, if you decide to investigate the huts, turn to 305.
S010-C02. If you would rather avoid the clearing, turn to 40.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S010-C01. Forewarned by this knowledge, if you decide to investigate the huts, turn to 305.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S011]
[PARAGRAPH 305]
Through the open doorway of the first hut, you can see the body of a charcoal burner lying face down on the rough stone floor. He has been murdered, stabbed in the back by a spear. All his furniture and belongings have been smashed and broken and not one piece remains intact. This is the evil handiwork of Giaks without any doubt, for they delight in the destruction of all things. A quick check of the other huts reveals a similar story of murder and wreckage. In the last hut that you search, you discover a Giak Spear—proof of your suspicions. You may keep this Weapon if you wish. More determined than ever now to succeed in your mission, you continue along the track.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S011-C01. Turn to 105.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S011-C01. Turn to 105.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S012]
[PARAGRAPH 105]
In the distance, perched on the branch of an old oak tree is a jet-black raven.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S012-C01. If you have the Kai Discipline of Animal Kinship, you may call to this bird by turning to 298.
S012-C02. If you do not possess this skill, or if you do not wish to use it, turn to 335.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S012-C01. If you have the Kai Discipline of Animal Kinship, you may call to this bird by turning to 298.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Kai availability or mechanical route

[STEP S013]
[PARAGRAPH 298]
The head of the bird slowly turns and it curses you. An instant later, it flies off above the trees and has soon disappeared. Shocked by what you have heard you are now sure that the fledgling was a scout of the Darklords and is now probably on its way to inform them of your whereabouts.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S013-C01. If you wish to continue your journey along the track, turn to 121.
S013-C02. If you wish to leave the track and continue through the forest instead, turn to 38.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S013-C01. If you wish to continue your journey along the track, turn to 121.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S014]
[PARAGRAPH 121]
After a few minutes walking you see a stranger, clad in red, standing in the centre of the track ahead. He has his back towards you, and his head is covered by the hood of his robes. Perched on his outstretched arm is the black raven that you saw earlier.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S014-C01. If you wish to call the stranger, turn to 342.
S014-C02. If you wish to approach the stranger cautiously, turn to 309.
S014-C03. If you would rather draw your weapon and attack, turn to 283.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S014-C01. If you wish to call the stranger, turn to 342.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S015]
[PARAGRAPH 342]
As your voice echoes through the trees, the stranger slowly turns to face you. Your heart pounds and your blood freezes as you realize that the stranger is not human. It is a Vordak, a hideous lieutenant of the Darklords and one of the undead. A piercing scream fills your ears, and the creature raises a huge black mace above its head and charges at you. Frozen with horror, you can also feel the Vordak attacking you with the force of its mind. Deduct 2 points from your COMBAT SKILL unless you have the Kai Discipline of Mindshield. You must fight this creature. It is immune to Mindblast. Vordak: COMBAT SKILL 18 ENDURANCE 26

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S015-C01. If you win, turn to 123.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S015-C01. If you win, turn to 123.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Combat resolution

[STEP S016]
[PARAGRAPH 123]
As the creature dies, its body slowly dissolves into a vile green liquid. You notice that all of the grass and the plants beneath the smoking fluid are beginning to shrivel and die. A large valuable looking Gem lies on the ground near to the decaying body. Further along the track you can see a large war party of Giaks running towards you.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S016-C01. If you wish to take the Gem, turn to 304.
S016-C02. If you would rather leave it and run, turn to 2.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S016-C02. If you would rather leave it and run, turn to 2.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S017]
[PARAGRAPH 2]
As you dash through the thickening trees, the shouts of the Giaks begin to fade behind you. You have nearly outdistanced them completely, when you crash headlong into a tangle of low branches. Pick a number from the Random Number Table.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S017-C01. If you have picked a number 0–4, turn to 343.
S017-C02. If you have picked a number 5–9, turn to 276.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S017-C01. If you have picked a number 0–4, turn to 343.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Random or mechanical resolution

[STEP S018]
[PARAGRAPH 343]
You are held by the mass of tangled branches and roots. Eventually you free your right hand, grab your weapon, and hack your way slowly through the foliage to the clearer forest beyond. Your cloak is torn in several places and your left arm is cut and badly bruised above the elbow.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S018-C01. Lose 2 ENDURANCE points and turn to 213.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S018-C01. Lose 2 ENDURANCE points and turn to 213.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S019]
[PARAGRAPH 213]
You have been trudging through the forest for nearly two hours. The nagging fear that you are lost begins to seem a reality. Apart from the occasional cry of a Kraan in the far distance, you have seen or heard no evidence that the enemy is in this part of the forest. As you descend a rocky hillock, you see something unusual in the tangled woods ahead.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S019-C01. Turn to 331.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S019-C01. Turn to 331.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S020]
[PARAGRAPH 331]
Surrounded by thorny briars and closely packed roots, you see the entrance of a tunnel disappearing into the hillside beyond. It is approximately seven feet in height and just over ten feet wide. As you get closer, you can feel a slight breeze coming from the inky blackness. If the other end of this tunnel emerges on the far side of the hill, it could save you many hours of difficult climbing. But it could also harbour unknown danger.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S020-C01. If you wish to enter the tunnel, turn to 170.
S020-C02. If you would prefer to climb the hillside, turn to 280.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S020-C02. If you would prefer to climb the hillside, turn to 280.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S021]
[PARAGRAPH 280]
As you begin your climb, you hear the beat of wings approaching from the west. Kraan! By the noise they are making you estimate there are at least ten, perhaps more. You curse your bad luck, for the hillside offers no cover from the sky. If you are attacked during this difficult climb, you will find it nearly impossible to fight back and remain upright at the same time.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S021-C01. If you decide to draw your weapon and remain completely still, in the hope that the Kraan will not spot you, turn to 327.
S021-C02. If you decide to quickly descend the hillside and take cover in the tunnel, turn to 170.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S021-C02. If you decide to quickly descend the hillside and take cover in the tunnel, turn to 170.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S022]
[PARAGRAPH 170]
The tunnel is dark and the air is much cooler than outside. You carefully advance with one hand on the tunnel wall to aid your sense of direction. You have been in total darkness for three minutes when you detect the foul smell of decay ahead, similar to rotting meat. If you have a Torch and Tinderbox in your Pack, you may light the Torch to see your way ahead. Suddenly, something heavy drops from the tunnel ceiling onto your back and you fall to your knees. It is a Burrowcrawler and you must fight it, for it is trying to strangle you with its long slimy tentacles. Burrowcrawler: COMBAT SKILL 17 ENDURANCE 7 If you do not have a torch, deduct 3 points from your COMBAT SKILL during this fight. The Burrowcrawler is immune to Mindblast and Animal Kinship.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S022-C01. If you win, turn to 319.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S022-C01. If you win, turn to 319.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Combat resolution

[STEP S023]
[PARAGRAPH 319]
The slimy creature lets out a long, ghastly death-cry and collapses. You are near to panic and scramble to your feet, grabbing what you think to be your belt from the jaws of the dead beast. You can see light in the far distance, and you sprint for it as fast as you can. When you finally emerge into the daylight, you fall onto the leafy ground and fight for breath in painful gasps. Slowly sitting upright, you notice that you are still wearing your belt—you had not lost it after all. What you grabbed from the jaw of the Burrowcrawler was a leather strap with a small pouch and a sheathed Dagger halfway along it. You break open the clasp to find it contains 20 Gold Crowns. You may take both the Dagger and the Crowns if you are able to. Feeling a little better now, you gather your Equipment together and push on eastwards into the forest.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S023-C01. Turn to 157.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S023-C01. Turn to 157.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S024]
[PARAGRAPH 157]
The forest begins to thin out until finally you can make out a road through the trees ahead. The highway is full of people heading south. Many are wheeling their possessions along on handcarts.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S024-C01. If you wish to join the refugees and perhaps learn more of what has happened in the north, turn to 30.
S024-C02. If you would prefer to continue to move south but under cover of the trees, turn to 167.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S024-C02. If you would prefer to continue to move south but under cover of the trees, turn to 167.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S025]
[PARAGRAPH 167]
You have been travelling for about a mile when you notice two legs sticking out from behind a large boulder.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S025-C01. If you possess and wish to use the Kai Discipline of Sixth Sense, turn to 178.
S025-C02. If you wish to take a closer look, turn to 88.
S025-C03. If you would rather avoid meeting their owner and press on into the forest, turn to 264.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S025-C03. If you would rather avoid meeting their owner and press on into the forest, turn to 264.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S026]
[PARAGRAPH 264]
You have not gone far when you hear the sound of battle to the west.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S026-C01. If you wish to follow the sound, turn to 97.
S026-C02. If you would rather continue south, turn to 6.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S026-C01. If you wish to follow the sound, turn to 97.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S027]
[PARAGRAPH 97]
Ahead of you, you can see a fierce battle raging across a stone bridge. The clash of steel and the cries of men and beasts echo through the forest. In the midst of the fighting, you see Prince Pelathar, the King’s son. He is in combat with a large grey Gourgaz who is wielding a black axe above his scaly head. Suddenly, the Prince falls wounded—a black arrow in his side.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S027-C01. If you wish to defend the fallen Prince, turn to 255.
S027-C02. If you wish to run into the forest, turn to 306.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S027-C02. If you wish to run into the forest, turn to 306.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S028]
[PARAGRAPH 306]
The sound of battle gradually fades behind you. Suddenly, you are pulled to the ground. Three Drakkarim have dropped from a tree above. You struggle but it is useless for there are too many of them for you and they are very strong. The last thing that you hear is the vicious snarls of Drakkarim as they raise their spears. Your life and your mission end here.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
None.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
The narrative ending is reached.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Story outcome

[STEP S003]
[PARAGRAPH 56]
You hear the scream of a large winged beast above the trees. It is a Kraan, a deadly servant of the Darklords. Quickly you hide beneath the thick fronds of fern until the horrible shrieks have passed away.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S003-C01. Now turn to 222.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S003-C01. Now turn to 222.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S004]
[PARAGRAPH 222]
As you go on you discover a forest path that divides at the point you join it.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S004-C01. If you wish to use your Kai Discipline of Tracking, turn to 67.
S004-C02. If you wish to take the south fork, turn to 140.
S004-C03. If you wish to take the east fork, turn to 252.

Player choice

Player choice

[PARAGRAPH 155]

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S006-C01. Turn to 70.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S006-C01. Turn to 70.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S007]
[PARAGRAPH 70]
You have reached a small bridge. A track follows the stream towards the east. A much narrower path disappears into thick forest towards the south.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S007-C01. If you wish to use the Kai Discipline of Sixth Sense, turn to 8.
S007-C02. If you wish to go east, turn to 28.
S007-C03. If you wish to go south, turn to 157.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S007-C03. If you wish to go south, turn to 157.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[PARAGRAPH 157]
The forest begins to thin out until finally you can make out a road through the trees ahead. The highway is full of people heading south. Many are wheeling their possessions along on handcarts.

S008-C01. If you wish to join the refugees and perhaps learn more of what has happened in the north, turn to 30.
S008-C02. If you would prefer to continue to move south but under cover of the trees, turn to 167.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S008-C01. If you wish to join the refugees and perhaps learn more of what has happened in the north, turn to 30.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S009]
[PARAGRAPH 30]
The people look tired and hungry. They have come many miles from their burning city. Suddenly, you hear the beat of huge wings coming from the north. ‘Kraan, Kraan! Hide yourselves!’ the cry goes up all along the road. Just in front of you, a wagon carrying small children breaks down, its right wheel jammed in a furrow. The children scream in panic.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S009-C01. If you wish to help the children, turn to 194.
S009-C02. If you’d rather run for the cover of the trees, turn to 261.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S009-C01. If you wish to help the children, turn to 194.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S010]
[PARAGRAPH 194]
You sprint towards the wagon. People are running everywhere in panic as the Kraan make their attack, carrying their poor victims off into the darkening sky. A large Kraan is hovering above the wagon and three snarling Giaks drop from its back onto the startled horses. You must fight them or leave the wagon and run to the safety of a nearby farmhouse.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S010-C01. If you wish to fight the Giaks, turn to 208.
S010-C02. If you wish to run to the farmhouse, turn to 148.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S010-C01. If you wish to fight the Giaks, turn to 208.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S011]
[PARAGRAPH 208]
The ghoulish creatures thrust their spears at you and attack. Fight these creatures as a single enemy. Giaks: COMBAT SKILL 15 ENDURANCE 13

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S011-C01. If you win, you can run to the safety of the farmhouse by turning to 148.
S011-C02. Or you can return to the woods by turning to 320.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S011-C02. Or you can return to the woods by turning to 320.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Player choice

[STEP S012]
[PARAGRAPH 320]
As you race across the open field towards the wood, a Kraan dives at you and claws your arm. Before you can fight back, it has flown off again, shrieking with cold malice. You enter the wood, but you have lost 2 ENDURANCE points.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S012-C01. Turn to 264.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S012-C01. Turn to 264.

[TRANSITION TYPE]

[STEP S001]
[PARAGRAPH 1]
You must make haste for you sense it is not safe to linger by the smoking remains of the ruined monastery. The black-winged beasts could return at any moment. You must set out for the Sommlending capital of Holmgard and tell the King the terrible news of the massacre: that the whole élite of Kai warriors, save yourself, have been slaughtered. Without the Kai Lords to lead her armies, Sommerlund will be at the mercy of their ancient enemy, the Darklords. Fighting back tears, you bid farewell to your dead kinsmen. Silently, you promise that their deaths will be avenged. You turn away from the ruins and carefully descend the steep track. At the foot of the hill, the path splits into two directions, both leading into a large wood.

Looking up you can just make out the shape of a Kraan approaching from the north. It is one of the monsters that attacked the monastery and on its back are two grey-skinned creatures armed with long spears. These are Mountain Giaks—evil servants of the Darklords, full of hatred and malice. Many centuries ago, their ancestors were used by the Darklords to build the infernal city of Helgedad, which lies in the volcanic wastelands beyond the Durncrag range of mountains. The construction of the city was long and torturous and only the strongest of the Giaks survived the heat and poisonous atmosphere of Helgedad. A war party of Giaks, some twenty-five to thirty strong, are attacking the ruins from all sides. Many more of the Giaks are dead or dying among the broken pillars of marble, but still they assault whatever is hidden inside. Suddenly, a bolt of blue lightning rips through the front rank of Giaks sending the armour-clad creatures tumbling in all directions. A Giak, taller than the others and dressed from head to foot in black chainmail, curses at his troops as he whips them forward with a barbed flail. With weapon ready, you move to the edge of the clearing, under cover of the thick foliage, and try to catch a glimpse of the defenders. To your amazement, the ruins are being defended by a young man no older than yourself. You recognize his sky-blue robes, embroidered with stars. He is a young theurgist of the Magicians’ Guild of Toran: an apprentice in magic. Five Giaks charge forward, their spears raised to stab the apprentice as he hurriedly retreats deeper into the ruins. You see him turn and raise his left hand just before a bolt of blue flame shoots from his fingertips into the snarling Giak soldiers. Close to where you are hidden, you see a Giak scuttle past and climb one of the pillars of the temple. [STEP S001]
[PARAGRAPH 1]
You must make haste for you sense it is not safe to linger by the smoking remains of the ruined monastery. The black-winged beasts could return at any moment. You must set out for the Sommlending capital of Holmgard and tell the King the terrible news of the massacre: that the whole élite of Kai warriors, save yourself, have been slaughtered. Without the Kai Lords to lead her armies, Sommerlund will be at the mercy of their ancient enemy, the Darklords. Fighting back tears, you bid farewell to your dead kinsmen. Silently, you promise that their deaths will be avenged. You turn away from the ruins and carefully descend the steep track. At the foot of the hill, the path splits into two directions, both leading into a large wood.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S001-C01. If you wish to use your Kai Discipline of Sixth Sense, turn to 141.
S001-C02. If you wish to take the right path into the wood, turn to 85.
S001-C03. If you wish to follow the left track, turn to 275.

[TRANSITION TYPE]

[PARAGRAPH 141]
Your Sixth Sense has warned you that some of the creatures that attacked the monastery are searching the two paths for any survivors of their raid, but you can avoid both tracks by making your way through the undergrowth of the woods.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S002-C01. If you wish to head south, turn to 56.
S002-C02. Or if you wish to cut through the heavier foliage towards the northeast, turn to 333.

[CHOSEN ACTION]

[STEP S003]
[PARAGRAPH 333]
You have cut your way through the thick undergrowth for nearly half an hour when you hear the beat of wings high above the trees. Looking up you can just make out the shape of a Kraan approaching from the north. It is one of the monsters that attacked the monastery and on its back are two grey-skinned creatures armed with long spears. These are Mountain Giaks—evil servants of the Darklords, full of hatred and malice. Many centuries ago, their ancestors were used by the Darklords to build the infernal city of Helgedad, which lies in the volcanic wastelands beyond the Durncrag range of mountains. The construction of the city was long and torturous and only the strongest of the Giaks survived the heat and poisonous atmosphere of Helgedad. Hidden by the trees, you freeze, keeping absolutely still as the Kraan passes overhead and disappears towards the south. When you are sure that it has gone, you move off once again into the forest.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S003-C01. Turn to 131.

[CHOSEN ACTION]
S003-C01. Turn to 131.

[TRANSITION TYPE]
Forced transition

[STEP S004]
[PARAGRAPH 131]
You have covered about a quarter of a mile when you hear shouting and a noise like thunderclaps ahead. Edging nearer, you soon make out a clearing that you recognize to be the site of the ruins of Raumas, an ancient forest temple. A war party of Giaks, some twenty-five to thirty strong, are attacking the ruins from all sides. Many more of the Giaks are dead or dying among the broken pillars of marble, but still they assault whatever is hidden inside. Suddenly, a bolt of blue lightning rips through the front rank of Giaks sending the armour-clad creatures tumbling in all directions. A Giak, taller than the others and dressed from head to foot in black chainmail, curses at his troops as he whips them forward with a barbed flail. With weapon ready, you move to the edge of the clearing, under cover of the thick foliage, and try to catch a glimpse of the defenders. To your amazement, the ruins are being defended by a young man no older than yourself. You recognize his sky-blue robes, embroidered with stars. He is a young theurgist of the Magicians’ Guild of Toran: an apprentice in magic. Five Giaks charge forward, their spears raised to stab the apprentice as he hurriedly retreats deeper into the ruins. You see him turn and raise his left hand just before a bolt of blue flame shoots from his fingertips into the snarling Giak soldiers. Close to where you are hidden, you see a Giak scuttle past and climb one of the pillars of the temple. He has a long curved dagger in his mouth and he is about to jump on the young wizard standing below.

[AVAILABLE CHOICES]
S004-C01. If you wish to shout a warning to the wizard, turn to 241.
S004-C02. If you wish to run forward and attack the Giak when he jumps, turn to 55.
S004-C03. If you wish to pick up a chunk of temple marble and throw it at the Giak’s head, turn to 302.
S004-C04. Or if you would rather turn and leave the battle area and run back into the woods, turn to 101.

[CHOSEN ACTION]

Player choice

[STEP S005]
[PARAGRAPH 241]
The wizard heeds your cry and spins around just in time to loose a searing bolt of energy at the Giak. The creature’s head disintegrates in flames and its twitching body falls in a heap at the foot of the pillar. The Giak officer sees you and shouts, ‘Ogot … Ogot!’ to his cowering troops, who quickly run away from the ruins to the safety of the forest beyond. The young wizard wipes his brow, and walks towards you, his hand extended in gratitude and friendship.

[STEP S006]
[PARAGRAPH 349]
He is a young blond-haired youth with deep brooding eyes. His face is lined with exhaustion and the grime of battle, and his long sky-blue robes bear evidence of living rough in the wilds. He shakes your hand and bows. ‘My eternal thanks, Kai Lord. My powers are nearly drained. Had you not come to my aid, I fear I would have ended my days atop a Giak lance.’ He is weak and unsteady on his feet. You take his arm and sit him down upon a fallen pillar where you listen intently to what he has to say. ‘My name is Banedon. I am journeyman to the Brotherhood of the Crystal Star, which is the Magicians’ Guild of Toran. My Guildmaster has sent me to your monastery with this urgent message.’ He removes a vellum envelope from inside his robes and hands it to you. ‘As you see, I have opened the letter and read its contents. When the war started, I was on the highway with two travelling companions. The Kraan attacked us and we lost each other in the forest during our escape.’ The letter is a warning to the Kai Lords that the Darklords have mustered a vast army beyond the Durncrag Range. The Guildmaster urges the Kai to cancel the celebrations of Fehmarn and prepare for war. ‘I fear we were betrayed,’ says Banedon, his head bowed in sorrow. ‘One of my order, a brother called Vonotar, had explored the forbidden mysteries of the Black Art. Ten days ago he denounced the Brotherhood and killed one of our Elders. He has since disappeared. It is rumoured that he now aids the Darklords.’ You tell Banedon what has happened at the monastery, and of your mission to warn the King. Silently, he removes a gold chain from around his neck and hands it to you. On the chain is a small Crystal Star Pendant. ‘It is the symbol of my Brotherhood, and we are both truly brothers in this hour of darkness. It is a talisman of good fortune—may it protect you on your road ahead.’ You thank him, place the chain around your neck, and slip the Crystal Star 4 inside your shirt. (Remember to mark this on your Action Chart.) Banedon bids you farewell. ‘We must leave this place lest the Giaks return with more of their loathsome kind to put an end to us. I must return to my Guild. I bid you farewell, my brother. May the luck of the gods go with you.’
